h: Shettima says Peter Obi has little to offer Nigerians beyond statistics
p: Vice President Kashim Shettima has criticised NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi, saying the former Anambra governor offers voters numbers rather than solutions. Obi's camp has not yet replied in detail.
more: The remark follows Shettima's earlier jibe that drew a response from Atiku's camp.
Campaign exchanges between the APC and the opposition are intensifying.
